source_metadata.title: Time to Target Anti-Xa Level in Obese Vs Nonobese Patients Using an Adjusted Body Weight Heparin Infusion Protocol for the Treatment of Venous Thromboembolism
source_metadata.source_type: primary research report; single-center retrospective cohort study

source_consistency_warnings.message: Results narrative on journal page 1009 states 186 patients were excluded, whereas Figure 1 on page 1010 states 184 were excluded. The flow values 350 reviewed and 166 included are consistent with 184 exclusions.
source_consistency_warnings.handling: The excluded-count assertion was not atomized; the analyzed cohort count of 166 was retained because it is consistent across the source.

source_consistency_warnings.message: Table 3 on journal page 1011 reports overall median time to first target anti-Xa as 12.68 hours, whereas the Discussion text on page 1009/1010 refers to 12.48 hours.
source_consistency_warnings.handling: The conflicting overall median was not atomized; group-specific medians 12.45 and 13.03 hours were retained because they are consistent in the abstract, results, and Table 3.

extraction_limitations: Atoms represent assertions made in this article; cited background studies were not re-atomized as primary-study evidence.
No unreported confidence intervals or effect estimates were calculated.

QuantitativeResult has a single estimate field; for multi-group comparisons, the reported group values are preserved in arms and the estimate field stores one explicitly labeled reported group value rather than a calculated between-group difference.
Review status is needs_review because extraction and validation were performed by a language model without independent human verification.
